newsitem.title: GERMANY: German forwarder Dachser uses new barcode scanning.
newsitem.headline: German forwarder Dachser uses new barcode scanning.

text.p: German freight forwarder Dachser GmbH said it has introduced new bar-coding and signature scanning technology as an expansion of its logistics services.
The new NV Online technology will provide shippers with more rapid information on the status of their shipments, a company statement said.
The so-called "Pen Key" technology allows the signature of a consignment recipient to be scanned into the Dachser system and thus speeds up status information.
Dachser said it has now introduced bar-code recognition technology to all subsidiaries in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Benelux.
